sloka: दुष्करम् क्रियते पुत्र सर्वथा राघव तया ।मत्प्रियार्थम् प्रियाम्स्त्यक्त्वा यद्यासि विजनम् वनम् ॥२-३४-३५॥
transliteration: duṣkaram kriyate putra sarvathā rāghava tayā ।matpriyārtham priyāmstyaktvā yadyāsi vijanam vanam ॥2-34-35॥

translations.english: O my son, O descendant of the Raghus, you are called upon to accomplish, by all means, a very difficult task. For the sake of my pleasure you are forsaking your dear ones and going to the desolate forest.
translations.hindi: और तो और, उसके मुख की रंगत भो तोन चदली
